skills.name: activate_teaching_mode
skills.description: Engage voice-guided Teaching Mode. Activates real-time screen perception, launches the persistent floating visual lesson HUD, and locks autonomous desktop actuation to act as an interactive pedagogical mentor.

topic.description: The concept, skill, algorithm, or codebase to teach (e.g. 'Bubble Sort', 'Asyncio task groups', 'PipeWire audio routing').

lesson_layout.description: Visual presentation layout for the lesson HUD.

visual_mode.description: Interactive visualizer canvas mode (auto detects from topic: math, graph, table, sort, quadcopter, or whiteboard).

skills.name: update_teaching_lesson
skills.description: Update the persistent floating lesson HUD with explanations, syntax breakdowns, dynamic Graphviz diagrams, or canvas visualizer steps.

explanation_markdown.description: Concise explanation or bullet points (max 1200 chars).

diagram_dot.description: Optional Graphviz DOT syntax to compile and display as a structural diagram.

suggested_actions.description: Interactive buttons for student progression (e.g. ['Next Step', 'Show Code', 'Quiz Me']).

draw_commands.description: Optional list of vector drawing commands for the whiteboard canvas (e.g. [{'command': 'circle', 'args': {'x': 100, 'y': 100, 'r': 20}}]).

skills.name: exit_teaching_mode
skills.description: Deactivate Teaching Mode. Closes the floating lesson HUD, restores standard vision settings, and unlocks desktop actuation.

summary.description: Brief verbal conclusion or next steps for the student.

skills.name: teaching_status
skills.description: Query current status of Teaching Mode, active topic, step number, and duration.
